payload.description: Operation specific. The SIGN payload is documented in $defs/signPayload, which this schema does not enforce.

content.description: A qualified timestamp inside the signed data as well. Never with appendClause.

source.description: Absolute, normalized path of a regular file.

target.description: Absolute path that does not exist yet.

attachments.description: Further documents (absolute paths) signed with the source as separate data objects of one new ASiC-E. XAdES levels only, no eForm, never with appendClause.

appendClause.description: Appends the clause pages, and the clause XDC as an associated file, to the PDF/A source as one incremental update, checks the result as PDF/A-3b and signs it as PAdES in the same request. PAdES levels only; never with attachments, an eForm, a visible appearance or a content timestamp. A result veraPDF does not accept fails the file with PDFA_INVALID (payload message: up to five veraPDF rule lines, one per line) and nothing is signed.

pages.description: Absolute path of the rendered clause pages (a PDF).

source.description: Absolute path of the clause XDC.

name.description: Name of the embedded file in the PDF.
